seo_title: The one question that tells you whether to choose Shopify or Wix for ecommerce
seo_description: Most platform comparisons miss the point entirely. Your business model determines everything - not the feature list. One question cuts through the noise and gives you a clear answer. Learn more on my blog. #shopifyvswix #ecommerce #smallbusiness

pin_items.title: START WITH REVENUE SOURCE
pin_items.description: If 50% or more of your income comes from selling products, lean toward Shopify - if services are your core business, lean toward Wix.

pin_items.title: BUILT FOR DIFFERENT PURPOSES
pin_items.description: Shopify was designed from the ground up to sell products - Wix was designed to build websites and added ecommerce later.

pin_items.title: CALCULATE TRUE COSTS FIRST
pin_items.description: Transaction fees, apps, and add-ons can flip which platform is actually cheaper by the end of year one.

pin_items.title: STOP COMPARING FEATURES
pin_items.description: The platform that matches how you actually make money beats the one with the longest feature list.

seo_title: Why most Shopify vs Wix comparisons completely miss the point for your business
seo_description: Asking which platform is better without defining your business model is like asking which car is better without knowing if you need to haul equipment or commute in traffic. The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out. #ecommerceplatform #shopifyvswix #serviceproviders
cta: The full breakdown is on my blog - go check it out.

pin_items.title: WRONG QUESTION
pin_items.description: Better for what and better for whom - a life coach selling courses has completely different needs than someone shipping handmade jewelry.

pin_items.title: HIDDEN TRANSACTION FEES
pin_items.description: A business doing $5,000 a month in sales could lose $100 monthly to fees that never show up in the base price comparison.

pin_items.title: APP COSTS ADD UP FAST
pin_items.description: A service provider on Shopify can easily spend $50 to $150 a month in apps before their store does anything useful.

pin_items.title: PLATFORM IS RARELY THE BOTTLENECK
pin_items.description: Businesses thrive and struggle on both platforms - the difference is usually strategy and execution, not which checkout button they use.

seo_title: How to choose between Shopify and Wix without second-guessing yourself for months
seo_description: You do not need to read every feature comparison on the internet. You need to understand which platform matches how you actually make money - then commit for 12 months and stop platform-hopping. Get more info on my blog. #ecommercetips #shopifyvswix #businessdecisions
image_headline: Shopify vs Wix - how to decide
cta: Get more info on my blog.

pin_items.title: DEFINE YOUR BUSINESS MODEL
pin_items.description: Write it down in one sentence - if you cannot complete that sentence clearly, you have a clarity problem before you have a platform problem.

pin_items.title: LIST WHAT YOU GENUINELY NEED
pin_items.description: Go through the real checklist - physical products, digital products, booking, subscriptions, multi-channel selling, design flexibility.

pin_items.title: CALCULATE YEAR ONE COSTS
pin_items.description: Base plan times twelve, transaction fees, apps you would actually need, theme cost - do the math before you pick.

pin_items.title: BUILD ON BOTH FOR A FEW HOURS
pin_items.description: Your gut reaction after hands-on experience is more useful than reading ten more comparison posts.
pin_items.icon: two browser windows side by side

pin_items.title: COMMIT FOR TWELVE MONTHS
pin_items.description: Platform-hopping wastes time and money - once you choose, invest in learning your platform properly.

seo_title: Wix vs Shopify for service providers who also sell digital products
seo_description: Wix includes bookings, courses, memberships, and email marketing without extra app fees. Shopify wins on multi-channel selling and checkout conversion. Which one matches your actual business? #wixvshopify #serviceprovider #digitalproducts

pin_items.title: Wix BUILT-IN FEATURES
pin_items.description: Bookings, courses, memberships, blog, email marketing, and video hosting included without monthly app fees.

pin_items.title: Shopify CHECKOUT CONVERTS
pin_items.description: Shop pay claims 91% higher mobile conversion rate - they obsess over conversion in ways general website builders do not.

pin_items.title: Wix DESIGN FLEXIBILITY
pin_items.description: Pixel-level control over your layout - move elements anywhere, customize spacing exactly how you want.

pin_items.title: Shopify MULTI-CHANNEL NATIVE
pin_items.description: Direct connections to Instagram, Tiktok shop, amazon, Pinterest, and Google shopping built in.

pin_items.title: SERVICE-FIRST OR PRODUCT-FIRST
pin_items.description: If your website is primarily a trust-building tool, Wix fits - if products are your primary business, Shopify fits.

seo_title: From platform paralysis to confident decision - choosing Shopify or Wix for your business
seo_description: Stop treating this like a personality test and start treating it like a business decision. Your business model determines everything - one platform is better for you, and this framework shows you which. Learn more on my blog. #ecommercedecision #shopify #wix

pin_items.title: PRODUCTS VS SERVICES
pin_items.description: If selling products is 50% or more of your revenue lean toward Shopify - if services are core and products are supplementary lean toward Wix.

pin_items.title: WHERE YOU WILL BE IN TWO YEARS
pin_items.description: Planning to stay intentionally small means Wix simplicity is a feature - planning to scale to hundreds of products means start on Shopify now.

pin_items.title: NEITHER IS OBJECTIVELY BETTER
pin_items.description: One is better for you - make the decision, commit for a year, stop second-guessing and start building.
